name: skillforge-typecheck
description: Isolated dev/CI type-gate tooling. Kept OUT of the workspace on purpose: the runtime is zero-install (Node 22 type-stripping + the scripts/link-workspace.mjs junction linker), and the packages use pnpm's `workspace:*` protocol which `npm install` at the repo root cannot resolve. This sidecar owns the only npm deps in the repo (typescript + @types/node) so `tsc --noEmit` can run without disturbing that. See ../typecheck.mjs and ../../tsconfig.json.
